findings.sleeves: Thin integrated hems follow the upper-arm cylinders. The projecting, separate-looking cuff rims from v1 are no longer apparent; hands and forearms remain complete.
findings.crotchAndInnerLegs: The fly ends at a normal rise and the trousers separate into two distinct thighs without the elongated hanging wedge seen in v1. In the final light and dark close-ups, the inner contours open continuously into the lower-leg fall. The previously flagged ledge and reverse tooth are no longer apparent, and no exposed shorts flap or visible blend seam remains.
findings.boots: The unchanged redrawn boots read as a corresponding outward-turned pair with coherent ankle shafts, heels and soles. No obvious swapped-foot reading remains in the reviewed views.
